meta.name: upgrade
meta.note: Source of truth for boundaries. TypeScript types and Zod schemas in src/contracts must match this file. Change a contract only via the 'change a contract' workflow.

format: // ROLE: what this file does and what it returns (one line)
// INPUTS: what it takes, with types or shapes (one line)
// CRITICAL: the invariant or risk that must not be broken (one line)

composition.rule: Only main.ts may import infra and hand real port implementations to app. Everything else receives ports as arguments.

modules.job: Classify the terminal host from an env map. Pure function.
modules.extensionPoint: host rule registry (one rule per host)

modules.job: Resolve folder, run safety guards, enforce path jail.
Ask permission before any read. Honors --yes.
Inventory files with ignore rules, limits, and secret skipping.
Convert one stack's source into UI-IR.
Diff two UI-IR snapshots, detect renames, protect user edits.
Score templates against the UI-IR with deterministic rules.
Load and validate template manifests. No templates ship until Phase 10.
Turn template + UI-IR into a file plan, then journaled writes.
Render in a temp dir with mock data from the IR and bundled sample images. Never touches the workspace.

EnvSnapshot.values: Record<string,string> (only for an allowlist of non-sensitive keys: TERM_PROGRAM, TERMINAL_EMULATOR, WT_SESSION, TERM)

HostContext.host: vscode | antigravity | cursor | windsurf | jetbrains | zed | windows-terminal | powershell | cmd | bash | zsh | unknown
HostContext.signals: string[] (names of env vars that matched, never values)

WorkspaceRef.refusalReason: fs-root | home-dir | system-dir | user-folder-root | not-a-directory | not-found | no-permission | undefined

ScanReport.files: Array<{ path: string, ext: string, bytes: number }>

FrontendTraceReport.hits: Array<{ ruleId: string, weight: number, path?: string }>

StackFingerprint.candidates: Array<{ stackId: string, confidence: number (0..1), evidence: string[] }>

UIIR.entities: Array<{ name: string, fields: Field[], sourcePath?: string }>
UIIR.Field: { name: string, type: string | integer | number | boolean | datetime | enum | json | unknown, required: boolean, isId: boolean, relationTo?: string, enumValues?: string[], format?: email | url | image | money | richtext }
UIIR.routes: Array<{ id: string, method: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE, path: string, kind: list | detail | create | update | delete | auth | action | stream, entity?: string, params: string[], requestFields?: Field[], responseEntity?: string, requiresAuth: boolean }>
UIIR.auth: { style: none | jwt | session | apikey | oauth | unknown, loginRoute?: string, registerRoute?: string }
UIIR.realtime: Array<{ kind: websocket | sse, path: string }>

ReadinessReport.checks: Array<{ id: string, level: blocker | warning, passed: boolean, detail: string }>

TemplateManifest.name: string (cool name, e.g. Carbon)
TemplateManifest.category: business | student-friendly | portfolio | store | content | dashboard
TemplateManifest.stack: { framework: html | react, styling: css | tailwind }
TemplateManifest.requires: { slots: Array<{ id: string, needs: Field-shape-pattern, optional: boolean }> }

SessionManifest.files: Array<{ path: string, action: created | modified, hashAfter: string, backup?: string }>

SyncDiff.fields: { added: Array<{entity,field}>, removed: Array<{entity,field}>, changed: Array<{entity,field,from,to}> }
SyncDiff.routes: { added: string[], removed: string[], changed: string[] }
SyncDiff.renameCandidates: Array<{ kind: field | entity, from: string, to: string, score: number }>
SyncDiff.affectedFiles: Array<{ path: string, state: regenerate | conflict | skip-custom }>

scan.emptyMeans: no files outside ignoredDirs and secretNeverRead

refuse: Desktop, Documents, Downloads folders themselves (projects inside them are fine)
workspaceGuards.writeJail: Every write path is realpath-resolved and must start with workspace root. Symlinks that escape the root are refused.
workspaceGuards.wslNote: Warn when the workspace is under /mnt/<drive> (slow filesystem).

antigravity: TERM_PROGRAM=vscode plus VSCODE_* (if Antigravity inherits VS Code, UNVERIFIED)

behavior.ide-terminal: Use cwd as workspace after showing 'Working in <path>. Right folder?' and running safety guards.
behavior.agent-shell: Same as ide-terminal, never block on interactive prompts when --yes is set.
behavior.plain-terminal: Never scan cwd by default. Ask to open a folder: recent list, type or paste a path, or browse. Then pass workspaceRoot explicitly.

hostDetection.caveat: Env vars can leak into child terminals (a plain terminal started from an IDE). Detection is a heuristic, so the workspace confirmation and safety guards run in every mode.

frontendTrace.suspectBehavior: Warn, show hits, ask the user to confirm these are not a frontend.
frontendTrace.blockedBehavior: Refuse. Tell the user to remove the frontend and retry.

rules.match: package.json deps include react, react-dom, vue, svelte, @angular/core, next, nuxt, vite, astro, solid-js
root index.html containing a script tag
pages/ or app/ containing page.* files

blockers: routes-have-real-handlers (no empty body, pass, NotImplemented, bare TODO)
optional: boot-test: start server, hit health route or /openapi.json

sessions.uniqueness: Generate, check .upgrade/sessions/<token> does not exist, retry up to 20 times.
sessions.undoRule: Snapshot before write. Created files are deleted on undo. Modified files are restored from backup. If current hash differs from hashAfter, ask before touching that file.
sessions.crashSafety: Journal entry is written BEFORE the file operation. Undo can always replay the journal backwards.

syncDefaults.gate: Readiness gate must pass before any sync
syncDefaults.removedField: OPEN QUESTION Q-002 (default until decided: flag and ask)
syncDefaults.editedGeneratedFile: Write <file>.upgrade-new beside it, show a diff, never overwrite.

commands.name: upgrade scan
commands.does: Host check, consent, scan, trace, fingerprint, readiness. Writes nothing.

commands.name: upgrade sync
commands.does: Diff against last IR snapshot and regenerate affected files

commands.name: upgrade open <token>
commands.does: Show one session and its undo option

commands.name: upgrade doctor
commands.does: Print detected host and matched env var NAMES, for verifying detection

exitCodes.2: usage error or missing --dir/--yes in non-interactive mode

copy.location: All user-facing strings live in src/cli/copy.ts so tone is editable in one place.

phases.name: Foundation and contracts
exit: check script green on skeleton
contracts compile and validate sample objects
an illegal import (core -> infra) fails the boundary check

phases.name: Host and workspace gate
exit: table-driven tests over env maps for every host
plain terminal asks for a folder, never scans cwd
IDE terminal confirms workspace
refused folders are never read

phases.name: Scan and classify
exit: fixtures: empty, clean-backend, react-mixed, flask-templates produce expected verdicts
secret files are never opened (asserted by a fake FsRead)

phases.name: Fingerprint, first extractor, UI-IR
exit: fixture backend -> golden IR matches byte for byte
unknown stack -> status unknown with reasons
adding a second extractor touches no existing module

phases.name: Readiness gate
exit: half-built fixtures fail with the exact failing check named
finished fixtures pass

phases.name: Session engine
exit: kill the process after N writes, undo restores the clean state
edited generated file triggers the confirm path
tokens never collide in a 10k-run test

phases.name: Snapshot and sync
exit: add/remove/change entity, field, route fixtures produce the expected SyncDiff
custom/ is never in affectedFiles

phases.name: Template contract and matcher
exit: dummy templates rank deterministically for fixture IRs
invalid manifest is rejected with a readable error

phases.name: CLI experience and styling
phases.note: A minimal unstyled CLI shell exists from Phase 1 so the folder prompt works. This phase replaces it with the styled version.
exit: every use-case result renders in interactive, --json, and non-interactive modes
no logic in src/cli (boundary check)

phases.name: Generator and preview
exit: generated project builds
undo removes every generated file

phases.name: Template crafting
phases.note: Templates are built to the slot contract from Phase 7, named like Carbon and Afrind, grouped by category.
exit: each template renders from at least two different fixture IRs
